issues.description: In the problem statement UML, Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents() is specified to return String, but the reference solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int and the task text implies a numeric total. Students following the UML would implement the wrong return type and fail compilation/tests expecting an int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make all artifacts consistent by changing the UML signature to +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and ensure tests expect int). If String is truly intended, update the task text and solution implementation accordingly.
